                  Your information stays in-house

                  The team with which you choose to work is fully dedicated to your project. We mainly cooperate from Poland, and we do not outsource any of the tasks we are hired to complete. We may travel - for example to meet in-person - and bring the work along with us, but your project doesn’t travel on its own.

                  Information is at the core of our business and we make sure that it’s kept private and secure.
